🙏 Celebrate Chhath Puja with Bhojpuri Hits:
Chhath Puja, one of the most revered festivals in Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Jharkhand, and other parts of India, is dedicated to Sun God (Surya Devta) and Chhathi Maiya. Devotees observe fasts, offer arghya to the rising and setting sun, and sing devotional songs to express gratitude. Our Chhath Ke Dinwa Bhojpuri Jukebox brings the festival’s spirit, devotion, and joy straight to your home.
